gate.signingIn: Confirming who you are with your LINE account
gate.toLink: This LINE account is not linked to a BCS account yet. Opening the link page
gate.toWebSignIn: This page is open outside the LINE app. Opening the BCS sign-in page
gate.ambiguous: This LINE account is linked to more than one BCS account. Ask your organization's administrator to unlink the one that is not yours, then open this page again
gate.anotherUser: This browser is signed in to BCS as someone else. Sign out first, then open this page again.
gate.tokenInvalid: LINE could not confirm who you are. Close this page and open it again from the menu in the LINE chat
gate.unavailable: LINE cannot be reached right now. Wait a moment, then press Try again
gate.failed: Signing in with LINE did not work. Press Try again; if it still fails, tell your organization's administrator
gate.sdkFailed: BCS could not start in LINE. Reload this page; if it still fails, close it and open it again from the menu in the LINE chat
gate.needsTwoFactor: Your role needs two-step verification before you start. Open BCS on the web to set it up once, then come back to LINE
gate.noMembership: This account is not an active member of any organization. Contact your organization's administrator

link.title: Link your LINE account
link.intro: Link LINE to your BCS account to get approvals and notifications in the chat, and to use the Request, Tasks and Track menu
link.settingsLink: Open LINE settings on the web
link.checking: Checking whether your account is linked to this LINE
link.checkRefusedTitle: Could not check the LINE account
link.codeNotNeeded: This link code no longer works, and you do not need a new one: your account is linked to LINE already. Its status is below

preview.heading: Check that this is your account
preview.caution: Link only if the name above is yours. If someone sent you this code, do not link: your LINE would get that account's approvals and notifications
preview.confirm: Link this LINE to this account
preview.outsideLine: Open this link in the LINE app to link, for example by scanning the QR code with LINE

done.heading: Linked
done.body: BCS sent a welcome message to the chat, and the menu below the chat now shows Request, Tasks, Track and Help

signIn.heading: Sign in to BCS to link
signIn.intro: This LINE account is not linked to a BCS account yet. Sign in with your work e-mail and password, then confirm the link
signIn.outsideLine: Linking happens in the LINE app: tap Link account in the menu below the BCS chat, or sign in on the web and scan the QR code in LINE settings

member.heading: Link this LINE to your account
member.caution: Once linked, this account's approvals and notifications come to this LINE
member.confirm: Link this LINE to my account
member.outsideLine: Open this page in the LINE app to link, or scan the QR code in LINE settings on the web

linked.heading: This LINE is linked to BCS
linked.unlinkBody: After unlinking, this LINE gets no BCS approvals or notifications; they go by e-mail instead, and the menu below the chat goes back to the unlinked one
linked.unlinked: Unlinked. This LINE no longer gets BCS approvals, and the menu below the chat is back to the unlinked one
linked.help: How to use BCS in LINE

other.heading: Your account is linked to another LINE account
other.body: This account's approvals and notifications go to that LINE account, not to this one
other.switchBody: Unlink the other LINE account first, then link this one to your account. The other LINE account will no longer get BCS approvals
other.unlinkConfirm: Unlink the other LINE account from {name}'s account?
other.unlinked: The other LINE account is unlinked. Confirm below to link this LINE to your account
other.passwordNeeded: Change the linked LINE account in LINE settings on the BCS web, after signing in with your password

outsideLinked.heading: Your account is linked to LINE
outsideLinked.body: Open this page in the LINE app to see whether it is linked to that LINE, or manage the link in LINE settings on the web

refused.TOKEN_EXPIRED: This link code has expired (codes work for {minutes} minutes). Get a new one in LINE settings on the BCS web
refused.UNLINKED_SINCE: This code was issued before the account was last unlinked, so it no longer works. Get a new one in LINE settings on the BCS web
refused.TOKEN_USED: This link code was used already; each code links once. Get a new one in LINE settings on the BCS web
refused.TOKEN_INVALID: This link is not a BCS link code. Open the QR code from LINE settings again
refused.ACCOUNT_LINKED_TO_ANOTHER_MEMBER: This LINE is linked to another member of the organization. The owner of that account must unlink it first
refused.MEMBER_LINKED_TO_ANOTHER_ACCOUNT: This BCS account is linked to another LINE account. Unlink it in LINE settings on the web first, then link again
refused.ALREADY_LINKED: This LINE is already linked to this account. You can use the menu below the chat
refused.LINE_NOT_ENABLED: This organization has not switched LINE on yet. Contact your organization's administrator
refused.FORBIDDEN: This BCS account is not active. Contact your organization's administrator
refused.SIGN_IN_WITH_PASSWORD: Unlinking another LINE account needs a sign-in with your password. Do it in LINE settings on the BCS web
refused.RATE_LIMITED: Too many tries. Try again after {time}
refused.RATE_LIMITED_LATER: Too many tries. Wait a moment and try again
refused.ID_TOKEN_INVALID: LINE could not confirm who you are. Close this page and open the link from LINE again
refused.EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR: LINE cannot be reached right now. Wait a moment and try again
refused.NOT_LINKED: This LINE is not linked to any account any more
refused.LINK_CHANGED: The linked LINE account has changed. Reload this page and try again
refused.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Close this page and open it again from the menu in the LINE chat
refused.FAILED: That did not work. Try again; if it still fails, tell your organization's administrator

help.title: Using BCS in LINE
help.intro: Use BCS in LINE to decide approvals, make requests and follow them from your phone. Settings and reports are on the BCS web
help.linkBody: First link this LINE to your BCS account. Approvals then come to this chat, and the menu below the chat gets Request, Tasks and Track
help.menuIntro: Once your account is linked, the menu below the BCS chat has these buttons

request.label: Request
request.body: Make a short purchase or service request

tasks.label: Tasks
tasks.body: Approvals waiting for you, the ones due soonest first

track.label: Track
track.body: Your requests and which approval they wait for

help.label: Help
help.body: How to use BCS in LINE and whom to contact (this page)

help.menuUnlinked: Before you link, the menu has only Link account and Help
help.approveHeading: Approving in the chat, and your PIN
help.approveBody: New approvals arrive as cards in the chat. Below the amount your organization set, press Approve on the card. At or above it, and for policy changes, open the details in LINE and confirm with your {length}-digit PIN
help.pinBody: {limit} wrong PINs in a row lock the PIN for {minutes} minutes, and BCS e-mails you. Set or change your PIN in PIN settings on the BCS web after confirming your password
help.unlinkBody: Unlink on the Link your LINE account page in the LINE app, or in LINE settings on the web. Blocking the BCS LINE account does not unlink you; approvals and notifications then come by e-mail
help.unlinkLink: Open the Link your LINE account page
help.contactBody: The administrators of {organization} help with accounts, permissions and LINE settings
help.contactNone: Your organization has no administrator listed yet. Contact the team that runs systems in your organization
help.contactSignedOut: Link your LINE account to see your organization's administrators, or ask the team that runs systems in your organization

pin.label: {length}-digit PIN
pin.hint: Enter the {length} digits, then press the confirm button

mock.intro: Test mode on this machine (LIFF_MOCK): open this page as a mock LINE user of the fake LINE server
mock.act: Open as a mock LINE user
